title: To Be Continued (JoJo)
blurb: That bassline belongs to Yes, from Roundabout in 1971, and the anime adaptation of JoJo's Bizarre Adventure borrowed it for episode endings in 2012 — after which the internet borrowed it from them. The edit format is perfect: freeze the frame at the exact instant disaster becomes inevitable, drop in the arrow and the text card, and cut. The slip has begun. The glass is mid-fall. The sentence cannot be unsaid. One of the greatest editing memes ever devised, and the bass genuinely still slaps.
origin: From JoJo's Bizarre Adventure's episode-ending freeze frames, set to Yes's 'Roundabout'.
